summary: Satellos Bioscience filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release announcing completion of enrollment in BASECAMP, its Phase 2 trial of forazapadin in ambulatory boys aged 7-10 with Duchenne muscular dystrophy, across 18 global sites in under nine months and surpassing target. No financial terms, stake, price or advisor appear. Management stated topline data is now expected Q1 2027, adjusted from prior guidance, to compile a complete dataset supporting potential FDA accelerated-pathway discussions. This is a routine clinical milestone disclosure, not a special situation; watch trial readout timing and any FDA regulatory interaction.
